verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh ships its own case management for reviewing alerts, with case assignment (filterable by assignee), case stages, recorded case decisions, and an API endpoint returning a case's audit log trail. Escalation is evidenced only as AI agents routing high-risk cases to human review, not as human-to-human escalation, and SLAs are absent. missing for 10: SLA or due-date tracking, documented manual escalation between reviewers or tiers, audit-trail detail confirming it records who approved and their stated reasoning, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why

citations.quote: Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
Filter cases by customer risk, case stage, who the case is assigned to, or when it was created.
They can then select a case decision of ‘no risk detected’, ‘risk detected- accepted’ and ‘risk detected- offboard’.
Returns the audit log trail for a case.
high-risk or complex cases are automatically escalated for human expert review.
